The procedure below walks you through creating a private BusTub repository that you can use for development.\n    22→\n    23→1. [Create a new repository](https://github.com/new) under your account. Pick a name (e.g. `bustub-private`) and select **Private** for the repository visibility level.\n    24→2. On your development machine, create a bare clone of the public BusTub repository:\n    25→   ```console\n    26→   $ git clone --bare https://github.com/cmu-db/bustub.git bustub-public\n    27→   ```\n    28→3. Next, [mirror](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-push#Documentation/git-push.txt---mirror) the public BusTub repository to your own private BusTub repository. Suppose your GitHub name is `student` and your repository name is `bustub-private`. The procedure for mirroring the repository is then:\n    29→   ```console\n    30→   $ cd bustub-public\n    31→   \n    32→   # If you pull / push over HTTPS\n    33→   $ git push https://github.com/student/bustub-private.git master\n    34→\n    35→   # If you pull / push over SSH\n    36→   $ git push git@github.com:student/bustub-private.git master\n    37→   ```\n    38→   This copies everything in the public BusTub repository to your own private repository. You can now delete your local clone of the public repository:\n    39→   ```console\n    40→   $ cd ..\n    41→   $ rm -rf bustub-public\n    42→   ```\n    43→4. Clone your private repository to your development machine:\n    44→   ```console\n    45→   # If you pull / push over HTTPS\n    46→   $ git clone https://github.com/student/bustub-private.git\n    47→\n    48→   # If you pull / push over SSH\n    49→   $ git clone git@github.com:student/bustub-private.git\n    50→   ```\n    51→5. Add the public BusTub repository as a second remote. This allows you to retrieve changes from the CMU-DB repository and merge them with your solution throughout the semester:\n    52→   ```console\n    53→   $ git remote add public https://github.com/cmu-db/bustub.git\n    54→   ```\n    55→   You can verify that the remote was added with the following command:\n    56→   ```console\n    57→   $ git remote -v\n    58→   origin\thttps://github.com/student/bustub-private.git (fetch)\n    59→   origin\thttps://github.com/student/bustub-private.git (push)\n    60→   public\thttps://github.com/cmu-db/bustub.git (fetch)\n    61→   public\thttps://github.com/cmu-db/bustub.git (push)\n    62→   ```\n    63→6. You can now pull in changes from the public BusTub repository as needed with:\n    64→   ```console\n    65→   $ git pull public master\n    66→   ```\n    67→7. **Disable GitHub Actions** from the project settings of your private repository; otherwise, you may run out of GitHub Actions quota.\n    68→   ```\n    69→   Settings > Actions > General > Actions permissions > Disable actions.\n    70→   ```\n    71→\n    72→We suggest working on your projects in separate branches. If all entries from the desired side\n * (mru_ / mfu_) are pinned, we instead try victimize the other side (mfu_ / mru_),\n * and move it to its corresponding ghost list (mfu_ghost_ / mru_ghost_).\n *\n * @return frame id of the evicted frame, or std::nullopt if cannot evict\n */\nauto ArcReplacer::Evict() -> std::optional<frame_id_t> {\n  std::scoped_lock lock(latch_);\n\n  // No evictable (status->arc_status_ == ArcStatus::MRU) {\n      src_list.erase(status->mru_iter_);\n    } else {\n      src_list.erase(status->mfu_iter_);\n    }\n\n    // Add to ghost list (front)\n    ghost_list.push_front(page_id);\n\n    // Update ghost map\n    auto ghost_status_ptr = std::make_shared<FrameStatus>(page_id, INVALID_FRAME_ID, false, ghost_status);\n    ghost_status_ptr->ghost_iter_ = ghost_list.begin();\n    ghost_map_[page_id] = ghost_status_ptr;\n\n    // Remove from alive map\n    alive_map_.erase(frame_id);\n\n    // Trim ghost list if needed (should not exceed c)\n    while (ghost_list.size() > replacer_size_) {\n      auto old_page = ghost_list.back();\n      ghost_list.pop_back();\n      ghost_map_.erase(old_page);\n    }\n\n
